summary: Luke Badiali reviewed referral sources with Chris and Leanne. Beyond the three PE houses, referrals come informally from a handful of transaction services and interim management firms. We agreed to formalise two referral partnerships and test a joint offer with an operational due diligence provider.

discussion.keyPoints: Chris listed 7 firms that had referred work, including two interim management agencies and a corporate finance boutique. None are tracked or thanked formally.
Leanne suggested partnering with an operational due diligence firm so Meridian is introduced pre-deal. Chris worried about conflicts if Meridian then delivers the work.
Meridian is not a member of any PE industry body. Chris questioned the value of paid memberships.

recommendations.recommendation: Formalise referral agreements with the two interim management agencies, paying a 10% introducer fee on first-year fees.
Pilot a joint pre-deal and 100-day offer with one operational due diligence firm on 2 deals.
Join the regional PE network as an associate member at £4,500 a year.
Give referral partners a one-page brief on the operating partner proposition and the 10-working-day mobilisation promise.

actions.action: Draft the referral agreement with the 10% introducer fee

nextFocus: Retention and expansion within existing PE portfolios.
nextPreparation: Leanne to map every current and past client against its PE owner.

tests.question: What introducer fee did we agree for referral partners?
Are we joining the regional PE network?
Is the due diligence alliance agreed?
